naro_mainline_correspondence.responsibility: All 290 correspondence/revision checks after independent LN/web freezes; material differences require separate original-source reading; no assumed textual identity.

edition_policy: Exact acquired Japanese digital witness, scoped by hash/colophon; no assertion of retail-binary identity. Missing content, substantive encoding/translation defects or material identity contradiction stops affected unit. Preserve originals.
placement_policy: LN01–09 in spine order, then acquired external stories by associated volume/stable inventory key, then two publisher stories, then full Kakuyomu E0001–E0431. Narō and other unacquired sources remain blocked; do not fill missing evidence from V1. Author-specific V09 paired-story order governs if acquired.
terminal_boundary: Every listed available source unit plus resolution or truthful blocked accounting for the exact listed source/discovery/correspondence obligations, followed by all architectural outputs; no future releases. A blocked mandatory requirement prevents comprehensive completed state.

excluded_future_sources.Kakuyomu: Episodes after immutable E0431 endpoint excluded
excluded_future_sources.Birthday_2026_SS_cards: Announced goods ship December 2026–January 2027; no published story at cutoff; excluded future release

extension_rule: No new release or newly scoped unit silently admitted; preserve I1 and require explicit inventory extension authority.
ordered_identity_rule: UTF-8 ordinal TAB unit_id TAB primary-byte-sha256 LF; multipart stories use SHA256 of ordered member TAB part-sha256 LF signatures; publisher image-only story uses narrative PNG byte hash. Full JSON hash binds all metadata.
